# 404less

> Open-source (MIT) self-hosted 404 tracking and broken-link monitoring. One Cloudflare Worker on the free tier: a snippet on your 404 page, a crawler, suggested fixes with a ready-to-paste redirect rule, digests, and a read-only MCP server.

404less is for people who run static or Jamstack sites (Hugo, Next.js, Astro, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel) and would rather host the tool themselves than pay a suite. There is no hosted plan. A cloud version will only be built if the waitlist shows demand.

## Pages

- [Home](https://404less.com/): what it does, and the cloud waitlist
- [Embed](https://404less.com/embed): the snippet, its options, and what it collects
- [Self-host](https://404less.com/self-host): deploy onto Cloudflare’s free tier
- [Agents and MCP](https://404less.com/agent): Claude Code, Cursor, and the HTTP endpoint
- [llms.txt](https://404less.com/llms.txt): this file

The dashboard is at [/app](https://404less.com/app) (sign-in at /app/login). It is disallowed in robots.txt, along with /api.

## What it does

- One script tag on the 404 page reports the URL and the referrer, and shows the visitor the closest known pages.
- A scheduled crawler checks links and assets, records redirect chains, and respects robots.txt.
- Each broken URL gets a suggested replacement and a redirect rule for Netlify `_redirects`, Vercel, Next.js, Nginx, or Apache.
- Digests go to Slack, email, or Pushover. Ignored links never alert.
- Read-only MCP tools let an agent open the fix as a pull request. 404less never writes to the repository.

## MCP

Authenticated HTTP endpoint: `POST /mcp` on the instance (production: `https://404less.com/mcp`). Protocol 2025-03-26, streamable HTTP. Header: `Authorization: Bearer 404l_…` (a key from the dashboard, API & MCP).

Tools, all read-only:

- `list_sites` — sites on the key’s team
- `list_broken_links` — broken URLs for one site (open by default)
- `get_suggestions` — ranked replacement URLs for one broken link
- `get_link_details` — hits, referrers, status, and the suggested fix

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http 404less https://404less.com/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer 404l_…"
```

A dependency-free stdio process for directory listings is `node apps/web/src/server/mcp-stdio.ts` (the root Dockerfile). It answers `initialize` and `tools/list` with the same four tools. `tools/call` forwards to your HTTP endpoint only when `F404_MCP_URL` and `F404_API_KEY` are set.

## Deploy

One click: https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/AshikNesin/404less

Manual, from a checkout:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm exec wrangler d1 create 404less   # paste database_id into wrangler.jsonc
pnpm deploy:worker                      # migrations apply on the first request
pnpm exec wrangler secret put RESEND_API_KEY
```

`RESEND_API_KEY` is what a public instance needs for email sign-in. Without it, a loopback host returns the magic link in the API response. The Workers Free plan covers a personal instance at hobby scale. Optional vars: `MAX_SITES_PER_TEAM` (default 5), `CRAWL_INTERVAL_HOURS` (default 24), `EVENT_RETENTION_DAYS` (default 90).

Install the snippet on your own 404 page:

```html
<script src="https://your-404less.example/embed.js" data-site="SITE_KEY" defer></script>
```

## Cloud version

Not for sale. The form on the homepage and the self-host page posts to `POST /api/waitlist`. Signups are stored so the project can tell whether a hosted version is worth building.
